what: Plan-review style instruction targets docs instead of the actual renderer
scenario_or_breakage: Updating skills/design/references/plan-review.md will not change the static or dynamic reviewer prompts produced by render-plan-review-prompt.sh, so the always-run plan-review panel can ship without the readability preamble while the lint passes on a doc token
suggested_fix: Add the minimal renderer change to read skills/design/references/readability-style.md and inject it into the emitted prompt, and update test-plan-review-prompt.sh to assert rendered prompts contain the preamble and no raw <READABILITY_STYLE> token
